title: Fidji Simo steps down from leading OpenAI’s AGI work due to illness
brief: OpenAI's Fidji Simo is stepping down from her full-time role as AGI chief due to a neuroimmune condition, transitioning to part-time advisor status. This follows her medical leave in April and comes alongside departures by COO Brad Lightcap and CMO Kate Rouch, signaling leadership changes at the company during a critical period of AGI development.
